chosen_concept.prompt: A floating channel current buoy marker: a round teal-and-cream painted wooden float body with a short ballast skirt below, a wooden mast on top carrying a bold weathervane arrow pointing in the flow direction plus a small sea-blue pennant flag, rope loops and a few barnacles near the base. Real size about about 1.2 m above the waterline, 0.7 m wide float. Stylised Palworld/Animo-class game prop concept, one coherent family with Quaternius-style medieval/fantasy wood and stone assets: chunky readable shapes, warm weathered driftwood timber, sun-bleached rope, teal and sea-blue paint accents, cream sailcloth, clean hand-painted PBR finish. Use the attached boards only for palette, mood, maritime timber/stone/blue language and finish quality. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no crimson anywhere. Single isolated object, full object visible, plain neutral light background, no text, no labels, no people, no creatures.
